notes: Same site/access method as bs58/na58 (Googlebot-UA pre-rendered HTML + same-origin /api/items REST call, tier 1 only, no block encountered). SALE vs CLEARANCE: the site's own top nav/taxonomy cleanly separates two distinct branches under 'Sale': (1) /sale/limited-time-offers/* - H1 'Limited Time Offers'/'Deals', a temporary promotional-discount branch (site-wide top-level /sale itself and /sale/limited-time-offers are 0-total category-selector hub pages; the actual listing /sale/limited-time-offers/all-deals has items API total=979) - this is a generic percent-off/deals campaign with no permanence signal, so it is EXCLUDED per brief Sec.3 Sale-vs-Clearance test, and (2) /sale/shop-clearance/* - H1 'Clearance' at the parent and explicit 'Clearance' wording in every child H1 (e.g. 'Furniture Clearance', 'Rugs Clearance') - this branch is INCLUDED, it is the site's own permanent-markdown/outlet-style taxonomy, structurally and navigationally distinct from limited-time-offers. Two top-level Clearance URLs both return real, different, non-alias totals: /sale/shop-clearance itself (H1 'Clearance', total=513) and /sale/shop-clearance/clearance-view-all (H1 'All Clearance', total=490, a curated 'view all' tab distinct from the parent's own total) - kept both per brief 'genuinely different listings, keep both' rule. Below them sit 12 genuine site-defined category/audience-scoped Clearance PLPs (All Baby, All Kids, Baby Bed Linen, Backpacks & Study, Bath & Pyjamas, Tabletop/Decor & Lighting, Furniture, Kids' Bed Linen, Rugs, Seasonal, Storage, Toys & Play), each confirmed via its own distinct H1/title and items-API total - none are aliases of each other. No sum-to-parent check is expected to hold (children legitimately overlap: 'All Baby Clearance' and 'All Kids Clearance' each already roll up several of the audience-specific children) - not an error.
